title: petasites stramineus
intro: Petasites stramineus, commonly known as Huang qin, is a plant species in the family Petasitaceae, native to China and other parts of Asia. It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antibacterial properties. The therapeutic actions of Petasites stramineus include reducing fever, relieving cough and sore throat, and treating respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
